faqs.question: Does this protein contain any kinds of steroids like anabolic steroids?
faqs.answer: None at all! This protein has just the things that your body needs to build muscle naturally, and nothing else to accelerate that process.

faqs.question: Does this protein cause bloating?
faqs.answer: No it does not. Man Matters Whey protein has a special digestive blend in it which helps you digest the protein with ease. Plus we source high quality whey, which ensures that there is no bloating

faqs.question: Does Whey protein have any sugar in it? Where does the sweetness come from?
faqs.answer: No, Whey Protein does not have any sugar in it. It has a non caloric sweetner added to it.

faqs.question: Will I gain muscle mass by consuming this?
faqs.answer: Yes, but you have to be consistent with your workouts, diet, and recovery. Just consuming this product won't give you muscle mass.

faqs.question: When should we consume whey protein?
faqs.answer: Whey protein can be consumed anytime of the day. Ideally its suggested that you consume Whey protein after your workout.
